Question B-002-006-006.

Why the correct answer is right: Through a repeater, report how the distant station’s signal and audio sound after being repeated, because that is what you actually hear from that station.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Your S-meter reading on the repeater output frequency": Your S-meter on the repeater output mostly reports the repeater transmitter reaching you, not the distant station’s audio quality.
- sourceIndex 2: "Your S-meter reading on the repeater input frequency": The input frequency may help a simplex test; a report through the repeater should describe the relayed signal and audio instead.
- sourceIndex 3: "The readability and strength of the repeater signal": Reporting only the repeater signal ignores the quality of the station being relayed.
